title: Outlook: Copilot insights on selected email text in classic Outlook for Windows
summary: Hold: the briefing implies that Microsoft 365 Copilot (Basic) users receive Explain This, although the published notice does not identify the eligible licence tier. It also turns an undocumented per-feature switch into a categorical claim that no switch exists, and attributes missing buttons to outdated Outlook builds without supporting documentation. The rollout facts, documented admin paths and licence-assignment API are supported.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; controls[1].note; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Licensing is unknown because Microsoft has not published whether Explain This requires the Copilot add-on or is available under Basic.
claims.quote: Searched: classic Outlook 'Explain This' 'User Initiated Insights' license billing Copilot Basic. Opened Copilot overview and license options; product-level licensing is published, but neither names this feature or resolves its Basic/Premium tier.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to 'included' for a new option within the existing licensed Copilot product, while retaining the narrower tier uncertainty. Use notes: 'Copilot capabilities are available through Microsoft 365 Copilot (Basic) without the Copilot add-on licence and Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) with the add-on licence. Microsoft has not published which tier includes Explain This.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/plan/copilot-overview. Do not claim that Basic includes Explain This.
